title: Check SSH Service
description: Verify that the SSH service is active.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

SERVICE="ssh"
systemctl list-unit-files "$SERVICE.service" >/dev/null 2>&1 || SERVICE="sshd"

if systemctl is-active --quiet "$SERVICE"; then
    echo "OK: $SERVICE is active."
else
    echo "CRITICAL: $SERVICE is not active." >&2
    exit 1
fi
